ordering_rule: card_id UTF-8 字典序，一次生成永久冻结，只允许追加
generation_note: initial generation (all cards, sorted by card_id UTF-8)
asset_status_rule: ok = downloaded & validated (non-flat); missing = download/validation failed or flat image; missing classes are skipped in training and always output unknown at runtime; conflict:true classes (identical images, different card_id) also always output unknown
conflict_policy: dHash<=3 且逐像素差>12 的改变占比<10% 的卡归为同一家族；家族内卡在运行时恒输出 unknown，训练导出时其概率置零（不参与竞争）。家族清单见 conflict_families。
